issue.title: test_bottom_pinned_body_stays_pinned_across_row_count_change loses the deck bottom pin when switching agents
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1kh.3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1, and triaged by its epic
land agent at master 1a638eac95b42c13014dd76c384dbfb56f5b323f on 2026-10-13.

tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel_preview.py::test_bottom_pinned_body_stays_pinned_across_row_count_change
fails deterministically. The test displays a short raw prompt, pins
detail.deck_area.panel(0).main_view to the bottom, then switches to another agent
with a longer raw prompt. The header row count changes as expected but
MainDeckView.is_pinned_to_bottom becomes False (line 402).

It failed in inherited check ToolRun d56f2c2ab1ea33c7551a9a0b7a8aeb83 before this
epic's commits, in the lander's serial rerun of that run's nodes (11 failed /
14 passed in 49.87s), and again alone (1 failed in 6.58s). The epic only changes
Git rescue, raw-commit finalization, and monitor CWD, so it did not cause this
TUI behavior. No tracked files were changed by the lander before either rerun.

Find the pin-reset cause and repair the behavior or prove an intentional
contract change and update the fixture accordingly. Do not mask the failure by
raising timing limits or skipping the assertion. The exact pin-reset cause has
not been diagnosed, so the task intentionally has size large and should plan
before implementation.

Adjacent task sase-1b8 concerns the same header/deck machinery, but its failure
is a settled scroll offset 2.0 versus 0.0 after an asynchronous pin operation.
This node loses the pin flag after switching agents and has no demonstrated
shared root cause; relate the reports so the worker can check for a common
remediation without assuming they are duplicates.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed in the inherited check, in a current serial 25-node rerun, and again alone with the same is_pinned_to_bottom False assertion; no lander source changes occurred between the reruns.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1kh.3 proposed inherited check failures; landing reproduced this distinct pin-state regression twice on current master and found no matching task or causal active epic.

payload.description: Both exercise header/deck pin machinery; this report loses the pin flag when switching agents, while sase-1b8 observes a settled 2.0 versus 0.0 scroll offset. A shared root is not established.

evidence.note: Proposed by E3 phase sase-1ko.5 (note #2). sase-1ko land agent reproduced test_bottom_pinned_body_stays_pinned_across_row_count_change failing on master 88acef6234 under pytest -n 4; E3 does not touch the deck header panel.

ToolRun e038beaf2eae2d193d2d8efc39901e60 failed test_bottom_pinned_body_stays_pinned_across_row_count_change (is_pinned_to_bottom False). Isolated rerun on unmodified master passed; loaded scoped-check lane still hits it. Not caused by this turn's agent-cli shadow detection.
